title: fix(spec,plugin-sharing)!: sys_record_share no longer offers a guest recipient, which no grant honoured (ADR-0138 D8)
body:
Fixes #23228
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a declared recipient value no grant honours is refused)

ADR-0138 execution card E4, decision D8: `sys_record_share`'s `guest` recipient is removed. It was declared in two places and honoured in none.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`: `RecordShareRecipientType` loses `'guest'` (now `'user' | 'group' | 'position' | 'unit_and_subordinates'`). The TSDoc says why it went and where guest access lives.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-record-share.object.ts`: the `recipient_type` select loses its `guest` option (a cross-lane touch, declared in the claim).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/translations/{en,es-ES,ja-JP,zh-CN}.objects.generated.ts`: regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=plugin-sharing`. Exactly the four `guest` option labels drop. Nothing was hand-edited.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`: `grant()` still refuses a `'guest'` that arrives untyped (a REST body). Its sentence now carries the prescription: the value was removed, guest access flows through the guest position and share links (ADR-0090 D11), and the caller should use a public form or a share link. Before, a guest got the generic sentence, which says sharing rules deliver non-`user` recipients. That was never true of a guest, because the sharing-rule vocabulary retired the same recipient. The prefix (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), the 400 status and every other value's sentence are unchanged.
- `.changeset/23228-record-share-guest-recipient-retired.md`: `minor` for both packages, with the **BREAKING** banner, the Clause-② line and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The gate admits it (see Gates).

## Measurements (at `c0569797a`, re-checked on the merged head)

- **H1, the declaration sites.** Confirmed across the whole tree, examples and templates included: two declarations (the select option and the union member) and four generated translation entries. Nothing else declares the value. `git grep` for a `recipient_type`/`recipientType` key written as `'guest'`: **0** hits. Control, the same pattern with `'user'`: **110** hits.
- **H2, where the grant refuses it.** `SharingService.grant`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` (the `recipientType !== 'user'` branch). The refusal is **generic**: every non-`user` value takes it. That branch stays live for `group` / `position` / `unit_and_subordinates`, so the removal makes no branch dead.
- **Readers that branch on the record-share `guest` recipient:** none. `plugin-sharing/src/**` reads `recipient_type` only as `'user'` in the gates and as rule-vocabulary values in the rule service. `explain-engine.ts`'s `'guest'` is `principalKind`. `rest-server.ts`'s `guest` reads are the `guest_portal` set and the guest entry, and the share routes pass `recipientType` through untouched. `platform-objects/**` has only the anchor positions. No branch was removed, and no live behaviour changed apart from the guest sentence above.
- **H3, which doors judge the value, before and after.**
  - The grant door (`POST /data/:object/:id/shares`, `grant()`): refused before and after. Now the refusal carries its prescription.
  - The row door (a system-context engine write: a seed, a plugin, a migration script; a user-context write is already refused by the `engine-owned` write guard). **Before:** the select admitted `guest`, so the write stored a row no gate reads. **After:** `VALIDATION_FAILED`, an `invalid_option` error on `recipient_type` that lists the four values a row may carry.
  - Route choice: the `spec-property-retirement` playbook's value-retirement route (`enumWithRetiredValues`) applies to a `z.enum`, and neither declaration is one. The union is a TS type and the option belongs to a platform object's select. So the prescription is carried by the union's TSDoc (the compile-time channel), the grant's refusal (the runtime channel every caller reaches), and the changeset. The row door names the legal values: the select has no per-option retirement slot, and adding one would be a new mechanism outside this card.
- **H4, the census.** No in-repo producer writes the value: seeds, fixtures, examples, templates, migrations or test rows. No seed dataset targets `sys_record_share` at all. Control: the examples seed `sys_user` and `sys_business_unit`. The tree has no `*.seed.*` files. Seed data is the one stored metadata surface that can carry a row value, and it carries none, so the disposition is the record's expected `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, not `registered`. objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` (`1fb1ced36`) has no consumer either: `RecipientPickerField` maps no `guest`. Control: `position` 6 hits in the same file.
- **H5, semver and disposition.** Pre mode (`.changeset/pre.json`, tag `next`). `check-changeset-no-major` refuses `major`, so this is `minor` with the **BREAKING** banner. `check-adr-0087-registration` refuses `no-migration-prescription` when the body carries a migration prescription (an arrow, a FROM/TO block or a framed rewrite table). So the changeset states what a caller now sees, in prose, and carries no FROM/TO block. The dispatch asked for FROM/TO; that is the one departure, recorded in the report. The accepted record's expected disposition and the gate's rule decide it.

## Pins, each with a negative control

| Pin | File | Proves |
|:--|:--|:--|
| grant door | `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.test.ts`, "[ADR-0138 D8] refuses the retired 'guest' recipient with its prescription" | the `VALIDATION_FAILED` prefix, the prescription's first sentence and remedy, no "sharing rules" misdirection, no row written |
| row door | `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/record-share-guest-recipient-retired.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver`, the real `SysRecordShare`) | the select offers exactly four values; a system insert of `guest` is refused (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `invalid_option` on `recipient_type`, options listed) and nothing lands; control: the same insert with `user` lands |
| census | `packages/spec/src/contracts/record-share-guest-recipient-census.test.ts` (repo tier, added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`) | over the radius declared for `@objectstack/spec`: no producer, no select option, no union member. Each leg has planted positive controls and a lit control on the real tree (the `user` producers, the `user` option, the `user` member) |
| type | `packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.test.ts` | `@ts-expect-error` on assigning `'guest'` to `RecordShareRecipientType`, compiled by `check:test-typecheck` |

## Ablation (on `f0d76f257`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one lock acquisition, each leg restored and proven `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty)

| Leg | Mutation (anchor hit 1, landed 1 to 0, blob moved) | Went red | Restored |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the select offers `'guest'` again (`sys-record-share.object.ts`) | row door: 2 of 3 (`options` equals the four; "the guest row was admitted"), and the `user` control stays green. Census: leg 2, "expected [...] to not include 'guest'" | `b2faffca45e1` |
| A2 | `grant()` loses the guest arm (`const retired = undefined`) | grant door pin: its first-sentence assertion fails | `0f9c977f5745` |
| A3 | the union names `'guest'` again (`contracts/sharing-service.ts`) | census leg 3; `check:test-typecheck` reports 3 type errors in `src/contracts/sharing-service.test.ts` (the `@ts-expect-error` and the `Assert` pin) | `26a2e9669ed3` |

No ablation needed a rebuild. Each subject is read from source: the plugin-sharing test imports the object by relative path and `@objectstack/objectql` resolves to `src`; the census reads source text; `check:test-typecheck` compiles `src`.

## Gates (final head `04410745d`, which is `git rev-parse --short HEAD` at the time of these runs)

`origin/main` was merged twice through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (merge commits, no rebase): at `48949dd35`, and again at `04410745d` after #23222 landed in `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`, in a different region from this change. Each merge was followed by the AGENTS.md §9 steps: rebuild what it touched and `rm -rf packages/runtime/.objectstack`. The branch's delta against `main` stays the 13 files listed above.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **89** families, the same set on `48949dd35`, `f0d76f257` and `04410745d`. On `04410745d` all 89 exited 0 on the first pass. `--ran`: "89 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The first pass on `48949dd35` had two outcomes worth recording:
  - `check-comment-mask-adoption` went red: the census had a private comment stripper, now routed through `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`.
  - Two `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` refusals (exit 3) were re-run after real builds, never counted.
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: "1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition", with `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]  not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`, after a real spec build: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". No artifact moved.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: 43 files, 1029 tests passed. `typecheck`: OK (test-typecheck debt unchanged).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 59 files, 1011 tests passed. `typecheck`: OK (`check:test-typecheck` 52 files / 246 errors / 135 signatures held, unchanged).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (local tier), on `f0d76f257`: 667 files passed, 1 skipped; 20230 tests passed. The merge to `04410745d` brought no change to this branch's spec files.
- The census's first full repo-tier run (on `ebcdce5d3`) timed out at 60 s on a loaded box: it masked comments in almost every file for its lit control. Since `f0d76f257` it masks only files that spell the key, and it runs in about 3 s.
- Not run locally, and declared to CI: `pnpm lint` (repo-wide).

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/sharing-service.mdx` lists the grant's `VALIDATION_FAILED` reasons without naming `guest`, so it needed no change. No docs page lists the record-share recipient types by name.
- The four tracked-ratchet artefacts (`api-surface`, `authorable-surface`, `json-schema.manifest`, signatures) are byte-identical. That is expected for a value narrowing (the playbook's route table), and `check:generated` is green with zero regeneration.
- The census matcher also reads `sys_sharing_rule` rows, because the key is shared. That vocabulary retired the same value earlier, so a hit there would be a resurrection too. Its declarations were not touched.
